Job Description: 
 Your Next Big Career Move Starts at DXC Technology
 We’re Hiring: Senior Full Stack Azure AI Developer
 Location: DXC Manila IPC McKinley Hill, Taguig City
Employment Type: Full Time

At DXC, we build strong connections, embrace innovation, and empower our people to grow. We’re looking for Senior Full Stack Azure AI Developer  who is motivated, skilled, and eager to contribute to meaningful projects.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade full stack applications using Azure cloud services, .NET, and Node.js
 Build and integrate AI/ML capabilities into business applications using Azure AI Services (Cognitive Services, Azure OpenAI, AI Search)
 Develop and optimize SQL databases, data pipelines, and APIs to support intelligent application features
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
  Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices for reliable software delivery
 Ensure application security, performance, and compliance with enterprise standards
 Participate in code reviews, technical design sessions, and knowledge sharing with the team
 Troubleshoot production issues and provide Level 3 support for critical applications
 
 Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
 5+ years of professional experience in full stack software development
 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, Logic Apps, Azure SQL)
 Strong proficiency in .NET (C#) and/or Node.js for backend development
 Experience with modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js)
 Solid experience with SQL Server and database design/optimization
 Demonstrated experience integrating AI/ML services into production applications
 Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Additional Qualifications
 
 Azure certifications (AZ-204, AZ-305, or AI-102) strongly preferred
 Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD
  Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, AKS)
 Knowledge of RESTful API design and microservices architecture
 Experience with Azure AI Services, OpenAI API, or prompt engineering
 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in an Agile environment
 Excellent communication skills; ability to work with distributed teams across time zones
 
 What We Offer
 Competitive compensation and benefits
 Professional growth opportunities
 A collaborative and inclusive workplace
 
 If this sounds like you, apply and take the next step in your DXC journey.  
 Know someone perfect for this role? Tag them or share this post!
 
 At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. 
 
 
 Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available   here .
